posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body: I did a bit of research and I was unable to find a roadmap for either product. Is there a public roadmap? If I was interested in investing in RPG Maker for pushing for development, who would be the appropriate department or person?

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body: Depending on the roadmap, some game development studios or tech companies are willing to go a little off road for about $10k. That's what we did at other places I worked. Most of the features I have in mind can be done in JS through plugins, but otherwise the only other way I can think to accomplish what I have in mind is with C# or Java with an external tool that works in conjunction with the RPG Maker engine. I might be able to think of a clever trick using C++, WASM, and NodeJS. Attach to the executable and bind on event listener. Pretty unorthodox, so I would rather just pay a fee and let them do it their way.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
So you want to bribe/commission/"invest in" GGG to add a feature to the editor of MV/MZ?
I guess it's possible if you became some kind of "official partner" and wrote a big enough check.
GGG's latest releases are RPG Maker Unite, WITH, and the upcoming Action Game Maker so that's presumably where their resources are concentrated right now.
